tasks.spec:
You are a specification writer drafting the streamline rebuild of the Mott SMS booking pathway. OFFLINE: no network, no git, no MCP, no skills; write only ./SPEC-v94-draft.md. This is a DRAFT for the owner's review - nothing gets built from it until he approves.

OWNER'S DIRECTION (Ankit, tonight, verbatim intent): the current flow is 'way too much duplication and no real spine, just ad-hoc development bolted on' - streamline it. The chosen architecture is the Contracted-Hybrid-Funnel option from the structural evaluation at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workSimplify/flow-structure-eval/report.md - read it fully; its inventory counts (nine extraction configs, four availability bodies, parallel slot-1/slot-2 branches) are the duplication this spec must eliminate.

LOCKED RULINGS (constraints, all must be embedded verbatim in a Rulings section): interpretation stays HYBRID (pathway extracts AND gateway re-interprets); week-level disagreement or detected ambiguity gets exactly ONE clarifying question offering the candidate dates, then proceeds (fail-open-to-search, never fail-stay; at most one re-ask - carry forward the v93 convergence design from /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workCFX/conflict-node-autopsy/report.md); clock times may NEVER be stated by any node without fresh slot data from the availability funnel (time-authority containment - enumerate the only nodes allowed to state times); every answer <=15s so NO filler sentences anywhere ('One moment while I check the schedule for you.' and 'Let me check that for you.' are both banned strings); corrections resolve offer-relative (offered date + 7 for 'no the following X' - as shipped in the gateway); no booking claims outside the confirmation node; the mandated close copy is unchanged; CVC portability is OUT OF SCOPE for this draft (owner: ignore CVC for now).

FORMAT DISCIPLINE: read /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/SPEC-v91.md first and mirror its build-spec conventions (numbered deltas, exact copy blocks, node/edge naming style, validator-assertion appendix). Read /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/pathway-v92.json for the current node inventory you are contracting.

WRITE ./SPEC-v94-draft.md with sections: 1. SPINE - one paragraph stating the single flow: greet -> identify -> ONE extraction definition (specify the five variables once, with the full extraction prompt written once and referenced by name everywhere) -> ONE availability funnel (single request-body contract, single entry node; specify exactly how time_pref variants collapse into parameters instead of duplicated bodies) -> offer progression -> ONE clarify gate (the T2 table embedded as the routing rule) -> confirm -> close. 2. NODE CONTRACTION MAP - a table of every current v92 node id mapped to its v94 fate (kept / merged-into-X / deleted), with the target node count stated. 3. EXTRACTION DEFINITION - the single canonical extraction config. 4. AVAILABILITY FUNNEL CONTRACT - the single request body and how callers parameterize it. 5. CLARIFY GATE - the one-question convergence design carried from v93. 6. COPY INVENTORY - every patient-facing string that survives, EN, with a ZH-parity checklist column (parity required before flip, authoring may follow). 7. VALIDATOR PLAN - the assertion set for the new shape (adjacency invariants incl. no fail-stay anywhere, banned-string checks for both fillers, time-containment assertion: no clock-time patterns in any non-offer node prompt). 8. HARNESS PLAN - the scenario set proving parity with today's 33 plus the new convergence/fail-open/latency scenarios. 9. OPEN QUESTIONS FOR ANKIT - anything genuinely undecidable from the rulings, each with a recommended default. 10. Machine line: 'TARGET_NODES=<n> FROM=48'. Honesty rules: where the evaluation report and the live graph disagree, the graph wins; never invent Bland platform capabilities not evidenced in the current graph. Final message <=15 lines.
tasks.check: grep -qiE '^#+ *1?\.? *SPINE|SPINE' SPEC-v94-draft.md || { echo 'FAIL: no SPINE section'; exit 1; }; grep -qE 'TARGET_NODES=[0-9]+ FROM=48' SPEC-v94-draft.md || { echo 'FAIL: no TARGET_NODES machine line'; exit 1; }; c=$(grep -cE 'n_[a-z_0-9]+' SPEC-v94-draft.md); [ "$c" -ge 20 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $c node references - contraction map incomplete"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'One moment while I check' SPEC-v94-draft.md && grep -q 'Let me check that for you' SPEC-v94-draft.md || { echo 'FAIL: banned filler strings not both named in validator plan'; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'OPEN QUESTIONS' SPEC-v94-draft.md || { echo 'FAIL: no open-questions section'; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'offered date \+ 7|offer-relative' SPEC-v94-draft.md || { echo 'FAIL: correction ruling not embedded'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'TARGET_NODES=' SPEC-v94-draft.md); $c node refs"
tasks.verified: A build-ready draft spec for the streamlined v94 pathway: one spine, one extraction definition, one availability funnel, one clarify gate, every locked ruling embedded, full node contraction map from 48, validator and harness plans - awaiting Ankit's review before anything is built.
